subject: Onboarding hardware kits — supplier shortlist and consolidated shipping SLA
body:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: PackRight Logistics <procurement@packright.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding hardware kits — supplier shortlist and consolidated shipping SLA

Hi team,

We are kicking off a vendor evaluation to standardize our new-hire onboarding kits (laptop staging, chargers, dock, case, and a small welcome bundle) and consolidate shipping to regional offices/new hire addresses. Primary goals: reduce per-employee logistics cost, shorten lead time to 3–5 business days for most US hires, and have a clear SLA for missing/damaged items.

Can PackRight share:
- A sample pricing matrix for standard developer/business kits (units: laptop + peripherals) for US shipping
- Proposed SLA for shipping and replacement timelines
- Any minimum order thresholds or warehousing options for regional consolidation

Attached is our current spec and estimated monthly volume by region — this is a pilot for Q4 (70–120 kits/month).

Thanks,
Dylan
Head of Workplace Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onboarding_spec_v1.pdf]

---

On Thu, Jul 16, 2026 at 10:04 AM PackRight Logistics <procurement@packright.com> wrote:
From: PackRight Logistics <procurement@packright.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding hardware kits — supplier shortlist and consolidated shipping SLA

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the RFP — happy to support. Please find an initial pricing and SLA pack attached. Highlights:
- Standard kit pricing (developer/business) with tiered rates at 50 / 100 / 200 monthly units
- SLA: 3 business days ground for continental US; expedited options at +$15/unit; RMA window 5 business days for replacements
- Regional consolidation: we can stage in three hubs (WA, CA, NJ) with drop-ship on request; monthly warehousing fee if inventory > 120 kits

We included a draft service agreement (packright_sla_draft.pdf). Open to walking through terms — I can make time this week.

Best,
Maya Singh
Account Manager, PackRight Logistics
procurement@packright.com
[Attachments: packright_pricing_us.pdf, packright_sla_draft.pdf]

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Onboarding hardware kits — supplier shortlist and consolidated shipping SLA

Thanks — skimmed PackRight's materials. Two quick notes after a fast price check:
- PackRight's tiered pricing looks competitive for volumes >100, but the warehousing fee kicks in earlier than I'd like (120 kits). Could hurt the pilot economics if hires spike.
- StaplesProConnect gave us a ballpark that was ~6% higher per-unit, but they include a free monthly returns window and no warehousing fee for up to 200 units. (Jack at StaplesProConnect shared an expedited program.)

I uploaded a quick comparison: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2bOnboardCompare — see tab 'Q4 Pilot'.

Question for procurement: can we ask PackRight to remove/raise the warehousing threshold and confirm replacement turnaround? If they can match or beat the net landed cost including returns, I'd prefer PackRight for their SLA flexibility.

-Laura
VP Workplace Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_comparison_q3.xlsx]

---

On Wed, Jul 21, 2026 at 09:35 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: PackRight Logistics <procurement@packright.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding hardware kits — supplier shortlist and consolidated shipping SLA

Hi Maya / PackRight,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Following internal review, two asks before we can move to an internal PO:
1) Can you confirm you will waive the monthly warehousing fee for the first 3 months of the pilot (we expect variable intake)?
2) Can you tighten the RMA replacement SLA to 3 business days for verified damaged units (currently 5)?

If you can accept both, please update the SLA draft and resubmit. Also include a sample DocuSign link for standard SOW + PO flow so procurement can spin up electronic signatures.

We'd like to finalize vendor selection by end of next week (target 7/30).

Thanks,
Dylan
Head of Workplace Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi Dylan / team,

Thanks for the clear asks — we can do both for the pilot:
- Waive the warehousing fee for the first 90 days (pilot period)
- RMA replacement SLA tightened to 3 business days for verified damage claims

I've attached an updated SLA and a redlined pricing sheet. We're also including a sample DocuSign envelope link for SOW + PO: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Example-12345

Best,
Maya Singh

Finance wants a final consolidated landed-cost summary before issuing a PO, but procurement is otherwise good to proceed. I've attached our PO template for reference.

I'll open the DocuSign envelope once finance signs off.

-Neha

Redwood Inference
